transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
Hello, Dr. Smith. I'm visiting today because I've been struggling a lot with focusing and paying attention lately. It has just been really difficult for me to stay on task.
Have you experienced these difficulties with focus and attention since you were a child, or is this a more recent change in your life?

Honestly, I've had these struggles since I was a young child, definitely before I was 12 years old. I remember always having trouble staying focused during schoolwork back then too. So it's definitely not a recent change for me.
Beyond difficulty with focus, do you frequently feel restless, have trouble sitting still, or find yourself acting impulsively without thinking of the consequences?

No, I don't really experience restlessness or have trouble sitting still. I also wouldn't say I struggle with acting impulsively. My difficulties are really just focused on staying on task and paying attention.

latest_inference.note: The patient explicitly denied symptoms of hyperactivity and impulsivity, which are required for the Combined or Hyperactive/Impulsive presentations. Since the patient confirmed onset before age 12 and current persistent inattention, the diagnosis is narrowed to ADHD (Predominantly Inattentive Presentation).
